title: shorea longiflora
intro: Shorea longiflora, commonly known as the "Yellow Meranti" or "Yellow Lumut", is a species of tree in the family Dipterocarpaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its potential to lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Shorea longiflora are attributed to its ability to exhibit antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antidiabetic properties, while its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids. The bioactive compounds in Shorea longiflora have been found to have anti-cancer, anti-viral, and neuroprotective effects, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
